issues.failure_explanation: The paper supplies finite double-mesh experiments, not a lower-regularity convergence proof. Moreover, in the interior reduced limit a u_0,x=f, at any fixed interior y different from 1/2 the forcing has a nonzero |x-1/2|^(2/3) cusp. Integrating produces a sign(x-1/2)|x-1/2|^(5/3) term in u_0. Its best affine approximation on an adjacent coarse cell of length comparable to N^-1 has error bounded below by c N^-5/3. A bilinear approximation therefore cannot satisfy the asserted N^-2(log N)^3 bound uniformly as epsilon tends to zero.
